evidence.summary: Approved design, status approved 2026-10-22 (commit 927f5d0). Sections: Intent; Decisions made by the user (9 items: term space, switcher and fan, screen dots and arrows, header title, edit-mode gating, delete space rule, icon and colour, saving rules, deferred items); Goals and Non-goals; Anti-goals; Behaviour details (fan, screens, edit-mode interplay, failure rule, confirmations); Data and API (migration, contracts, routes, revision checks, limits); Rename; Persistence (localStorage per device); Visual; Testing; Calls made by the designer (13 items); Left to the builder.

Seven tasks (rename and migration 9; contracts and API space operations; API screen operations; UI client and sync; pure UI helpers; screen dots and add/delete; space switcher). Global Constraints fix the icon set, colour keys, limits and title format. Its Deviations section lists two items (native ConfirmDelete dialog instead of ConfirmDialog; old-schema migration tests keep rooms). Step checkboxes are unchecked and the plan has no acceptance-results section, so it records no results.

scope.text: Rename rooms to spaces end to end: migration 9 renames rooms to spaces and screens.room_id to space_id and adds spaces.icon and spaces.color; API routes under /api/v1/spaces; contracts SpaceBoard and SpaceSummary; CSS classes .space*; theme contract selector .space--theme-<slug>; README and theme contract docs. Commits dbffb89, 46ad678.

API for spaces: create (one empty screen), update title, icon and colour (no board revision bump), delete (refused for the last space); revision-checked delete, with nothing deleted on mismatch (409); limits of 20 spaces and 20 screens per space. Commit 7387ee2.

API for screens: add screen (revision-checked, empty screen), delete screen (revision-checked, refused for the last screen, contiguous positions after delete, widget state and secrets removed). Commit 673bee9.

UI client and sync: API methods for space and screen operations; saveAndStay, switchSpace, addScreen and deleteScreen in space-sync; pure switch-flow reactions that never leave edit mode or reload on a conflict. Commit a486f95.

Pure UI helpers: fan geometry, header title format, screen choice after delete, last-open memory in localStorage with fallback to the first space and screen, delete-confirmation rule. Header «LifeDashboard» heading removed. Commit ef9f21e.
Screens on the board: ScreenDots with arrows (no wrap-around), add and delete screen, slide on switch, ConfirmDelete native dialog for screens with widgets. Commits e1932dd, 8f0a360, 68c5457.

Space switcher: corner button with the space icon, fan of space bubbles on quarter-circle arcs, SpacePicker for icon and colour, inline rename in the header, delete space from its last screen with confirmation, colour tint on the board. Commits 8fbbe7f, 170b59a.

Final review fixes: C1 (remembered screen kept on space switch; test first), I1 (header clear with many screens), I2 (conflict notice hint «Отмена»), label and comment fixes. Commits 463af11, 6ecb9e3, d152fb4, 9f21c81.

decisions.text: The term «пространство» (space) replaces «комната» (room) in the UI, code, API, database, CSS classes and docs of this feature. Rationale: the user's term (spec decision 1).
Creating, renaming, recolouring, re-iconing, deleting spaces and adding or deleting screens happen only in edit mode; outside it the user can only switch. Rationale: not recorded (spec decision 5).

Space and screen operations save immediately; «Готово» and «Отмена» apply only to widget layout edits. Switching space or screen in edit mode first saves pending widget edits and stays in edit mode, so nothing is lost; a failed pre-switch save blocks the switch and keeps the working copy. Rationale: no loss of pending edits (spec decision 8; Edit mode interplay).
A space always has at least one screen. The ✕ on its only screen deletes the whole space after confirmation; no other delete-space control exists. Rationale: not recorded (spec decision 6).

Multi-screen navigation is a slider-style dot row at the top centre of the header with arrows that do not wrap; the header title is «Дом» with one screen and «Дом (2)» with more. Rationale: not recorded (spec decisions 3 and 4).

Deletes and add-screen are revision-checked: on a stale revision nothing is deleted and the existing conflict handling applies. Changing a space's title, icon or colour does not bump the board revision, so it never conflicts with a widget working copy. Rationale: stated in the spec's API and Edit mode sections.
Icons are a fixed set of 24 system emoji and colours a fixed set of 8 keys, with no icon library. Rationale: as stated by the designer (spec designer call 2).
Limits: at most 20 spaces and 20 screens per space, enforced by the API. Rationale: twenty spaces still fit the fan on a 1280 px screen (spec Limits).

The last open space and the last open screen of each space are remembered in browser localStorage, per device; missing or stale ids fall back to the first space and its first screen. Rationale: not recorded (spec designer call 6).
No rooms API alias is kept, because the UI and API ship together. The theme contract stays version 1, because no user themes are stored yet. Rationale: stated in the spec (designer call 8; Rename).
Released migrations stay byte-identical; the schema change is migration 9 (user_version 9). Rationale: the spec's Data and API section (released migrations stay byte-identical).
Build mode, a new widget draft being placed, blocks switching: the fan and screen controls stay disabled until the draft is confirmed or cancelled. Rationale: not recorded (spec designer call 7).
